title: How many of your paper (either paper you authored or reviewed) are desk rejected? [D]
summary: Just spend 4h reviewing a paper while I was sick, gave it a 3/4. This morning got an email saying it's desk rejected. I saw many people around me also have many papers desk rejected. I heard, though idk how true it is, some people use multiple accounts to bypass the 20 paper limi
reason: Reddit discussion about desk rejections; no named model release, no research artifact/paper link, no industry business event, no policy action, and no OSS tool. No active rule covers it.
